chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"Zakat is not permissible for the descendants of al-Abbas and their peers among Banu Hashim." As for that which indicates that it is permissible for them in a state of necessity, it is what has been narrated:
ai.seo_question: Are the descendants of al-Abbas eligible to receive zakat?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific ruling for the Banu al-Abbas branch of Banu Hashim, distinguishing their status from the broader prohibition on Banu Hashim receiving zakat. While the general rule excludes them, the text explicitly notes an exception for cases of necessity (*darurah*), a principle supported by scholarly consensus to ensure their welfare when needed. This highlights the nuanced application of zakat eligibility within the Prophet's lineage, balancing honor with practical financial support.
